pretreatment: The Al particles were already covered with a thin native oxide Al2O3 layer, which may be contaminated by air exposure.
surface_functionalization: The Al particles were coated with SnO2 using the same parameters that were utilized for SnO2 ALD on the ZrO2 nanoparticles. However, the SnO2 ALD temperature was increased to 350 -C in an attempt to improve the SnO2 ALD growth per AB cycle.
